title: Supabase two-tone heading
description: A medium-weight geometric heading built from phrases in ink, grey or brand green, e.g. an ink line over a grey one. Three sizes (46px hero title, 34px, 22→34px section), with each phrase stacked on its own line always, only on desktop, only on phones, or flowing inline.
notes: the tones are text-foreground, text-muted-foreground and text-primary
name: supabase-heading

props.name: parts
props.description: the phrases, in order; the site's titles pair one ink phrase with one grey (or green) one

props.name: as
props.description: the element: h1 for the page title, h2 for sections

props.name: size
props.description: title: 34px → 46px (hero) · large: 34px everywhere · section: 22px on phones → 34px

props.name: stack
props.description: where each phrase starts a new line: always, from desktop up, on phones only, or never
